description: Source code for settings storage management in Zephyr RTOS, including functions for registering, loading, saving, and deleting configuration data, as well as managing configuration stores and handlers.

methods.name: settings_src_register
methods.description: Registers a new settings source by appending it to the load sources list.

methods.name: settings_dst_register
methods.description: Sets the destination store for saving settings.

methods.name: settings_load
methods.description: Loads all settings from the root subtree.

methods.name: settings_load_subtree
methods.description: Loads settings from a specified subtree, applying configuration from all registered sources.

methods.name: settings_load_subtree_direct
methods.description: Loads settings from a specified subtree with a callback for each loaded item.

methods.name: settings_save_one
methods.description: Saves a single configuration value, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: settings_delete
methods.description: Deletes a configuration item by saving it with a NULL value.

methods.name: settings_save
methods.description: Saves all configuration data using the registered store and handlers.

methods.name: settings_storage_get
methods.description: Retrieves the storage backend for settings.
